loss: sum span binary logistic losses + ridge/2 * squared coefficients; unpenalized global intercept
duplicate_windows: max raw GP, tie prefer larger attached boundary logprob; take both features from the same window
missing_note: explicit censored feature value for raw <= -4, with presence indicator; not an exact logit blend
scaling: continuous features mean/std on fitting IDs only; std smaller than 1e-8 becomes 1
types: one intercept for a type only if >=200 gold mentions in fitting partition; other types share global intercept
threshold_fitting: unchanged original and expanded decode-v3 grids with all/weighted_interval and one type pass
crossfit: same text-hashed two halves, all logistic/scaling/threshold/family fitting uses opposite half
acceptance: full-dev Micro >= v4, combined crossfit Micro > v4, neither held-out-fold Micro decreases
scope: exploratory development tuning, not independent test evidence
